B0-soft-area.definition: 49 exact relevant-object cell occupancy fractions plus exact continuous visible-area fraction

B1-binary.visible_area: not stored; diagnostic area is mean binary occupancy

B3-ordinal.visible_area: not stored; diagnostic area is mean ordinal code

B4-binary-coarse-area.role: binary localization plus one coarse-scale alternative

distance.B0-soft-area: mean absolute difference over 49 occupancy values plus area
distance.B2-binary-area: mean absolute difference over 49 binary cells plus continuous area
distance.B3-ordinal: mean absolute ordinal-code difference over 49 cells
distance.B4-binary-coarse-area: mean absolute difference over 49 binary cells plus coarse area code

decoder_definitions.allowed_inputs: frozen natural CLIP ViT-B/32 patch features [49,512] only

C3-local-context.spatial_layers: one 3x3 depthwise convolution plus one 1x1 pointwise convolution
C3-local-context.area_layers: pooled contextual 32-D feature to width32 head

decoder_definitions.early_stopping: Within each leave-one-init-out calibration fold retain the epoch with minimum validation training objective; final epoch is round-half-up median of four fold epochs.
decoder_definitions.threshold_selection: maximize calibration OOF IoU, then balanced accuracy, then choose lower threshold
decoder_definitions.binary_loss: BCEWithLogits with calibration-derived positive weight clipped to [1,20]
decoder_definitions.ordinal_loss: three-class cross entropy with calibration-derived inverse-frequency weights clipped to [0.25,20]
decoder_definitions.continuous_area_loss: sigmoid MSE weighted by 10 in the joint objective
decoder_definitions.coarse_area_loss: three-class cross entropy with calibration-derived inverse-frequency weights clipped to [0.25,20]

decision.prototype_scope_if_go: seed11 single-model offline spatial World Model mechanism prototype only

decision_amendment.scope: label mapping only; all numeric arrays, metrics, intervals, gates, block type, selected target, and authorizations unchanged

candidate_headroom_reference.gate_role: discussion only; does not alter extraction gates
